tagging_basis: AQA 7037 specification codes; AS units mapped to the matching A-level leaf

units.summary: Outline how the water cycle and carbon cycle relate to each other in the atmosphere.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 point-marked outline of a linked cycles idea; short recall though cross-cycle.

units.summary: Analyse a figure on deforestation, afforestation and land surface temperature at different latitudes.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of a multi-variable graph; data manipulation, no recall.

units.summary: With a studied river catchment, assess factors that affect the flood hydrograph.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark case-study essay (AO1=10 AO2=10) weighing environmental and human factors on a hydrograph.

units.summary: Outline how wind transports sediment in hot deserts.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of creep, saltation and suspension; familiar recall.

units.summary: Analyse two maps of seasonal average rainfall across Saudi Arabia.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of two isoline or point maps; patterns and anomalies with data manipulation.

units.summary: Using a Namib Desert photograph and own knowledge, assess relative importance of factors in its development.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1=2 AO2=4 short assess applying dune formation knowledge to an unfamiliar image and notes.

units.summary: Assess how far understanding feedback systems can help reduce desertification.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay linking systems concepts to desertification management; synoptic application and evaluation.

units.summary: Outline how waves transport sediment at the coast.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of constructive and destructive wave effects; recall.

units.summary: Analyse the distribution of coastal erosion and accretion on selected European coastlines.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 map analysis of spatial pattern with anomalies; no recall.

units.summary: Using a Humber Estuary photograph and own knowledge, assess factors behind the development of a landform.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1=2 AO2=4 short assess applying spit formation to an unfamiliar image.

units.summary: Assess how far understanding feedback systems can help manage studied coastal landscapes.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay applying systems concepts to management; case studies required and evaluative judgement.

units.summary: Outline the processes by which glaciers erode the landscape.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of plucking and abrasion; recall.

units.summary: Analyse surface velocity data for various glaciers including Thwaites Glacier.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 interpretation of a complex graph or map of velocities; anomalies and data manipulation.

units.summary: Using an aerial photograph of a Canadian periglacial landscape, assess factors behind its development.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO1=2 AO2=4 short assess applying thermokarst and periglacial knowledge to a novel image.

units.summary: Assess how far understanding feedback systems can help manage studied cold environments.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay combining systems theory with management; case study evidence and evaluation.

units.summary: Outline the Hazard Management Cycle.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline of a named model; recall.

units.summary: Assess how far global governance is crucial in reducing the incidence of wildfires.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess (AO1=4 AO2=5) requiring synoptic link to global governance and judgement.

units.summary: Assess how far plate tectonic theory explains landforms associated with plate movement.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay across seismic and volcanic landforms; evaluative judgement on the theory.

units.summary: Outline human effects on succession in a studied plagioclimax such as heather moorland.
units.difficulty_basis: 4-mark AO1 outline using one familiar example; recall.

units.summary: Analyse data on climate extremes and impacts on coral and forests in tropical regions.
units.difficulty_basis: 6-mark AO3 analysis of a complex figure with data manipulation; no recall.

units.summary: Assess how far global governance has a role in conserving the savanna grassland biome.
units.difficulty_basis: 9-mark assess (AO1=4 AO2=5) needing synoptic link to governance and evaluation.

units.summary: Assess whether latitude is the most important factor in tropical rainforest natural development.
units.difficulty_basis: 20-mark essay weighing climate, soil and other controls; AO1=10 AO2=10 evaluation.
